dialogues.speaker: Roxane
dialogues.text: It's rare to get so much time to relax... Life without target practice is so quiet — it feels kind of strange.

response.speaker: Roxane
response.text: It's part of my job. Don't be nervous.

response.speaker: Roxane
response.text: Training for the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol has recently become more intense. We now have to practice shooting three times a week. Each training session requires firing off 120 rounds, with the 10 worst performers having to run 10 laps around the training ground.

response.speaker: Roxane
response.text: A lot of people say it leaves a buzzing between their ears, but once you get used to it, I think it's exciting. It's like... the metallic clang of a hammer shaping iron. There's something uniquely pleasing about it.

response.speaker: Roxane
response.text: Turenna gave me earplugs to wear, but I never use them.

choices.text: Was your life not quiet before?

response.speaker: Roxane
response.text: I'd say it was very fulfilling!

response.speaker: Roxane
response.text: I plan to become the next exceptional sharpshooter of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol. I hadn't taken a day off in three months, so Turenna put me on forced leave and sent me out here to relax...

response.speaker: Roxane
response.text: Otherwise, I could still be training right now!

choices.text: It's good to relax, just make sure you don't neglect your work.

response.speaker: Roxane
response.text: You can count on me to complete my mission!
